name: Greta Borgia
source:
Emo girl, doesn't feel understood by the girls of her social class. Greta feels that while they have everything they want, there are people in the world who are starving.

She isn't interested in material things; she just wants to find someone who loves her for who she is and not for her money.

[In game description]
